about: Invented nights for tests and examples only (R2). None is anyone's. Every night a test or a plan uses lives here.

dreams: A lighthouse stood in the middle of a wheat field, and its lamp turned slowly even though it was noon. I walked toward it but the field kept getting wider.
Then I was in a kitchen with green tiles, sorting buttons into jars by colour. One jar would not close.
I had a dream that a paper boat carried me down a staircase of water inside an old library.
Jag stod på en perrong där tågen var gjorda av glas, och varje vagn var full av små citronträd.

nights.name: Glastrappan
dreams: En trappa av glas gick upp genom molnen.
Sedan cyklade jag över en frusen sjö med en kopp te i handen.
Till sist hittade jag en nyckel i fickan som passade i alla dörrar.
